query: I just opened PR #12 for this branch. Wait for the code review bot to finish, fix whatever it flags, and keep going until it says LGTM.
expected_behavior: Waits only with the bundled wait-for-review.mjs script, run in the background with a deadline, instead of a hand-written sleep loop or gh run watch
Notices that the repository has no remote or pull request and reports that instead of waiting forever
Does not invent findings or push

query: CI and the reviewer left comments on my pull request. Can you go through the feedback and handle it?
expected_behavior: Plans to read issue comments, inline review comments, and review threads, including hidden instructions from automated reviewers
Plans to verify each finding before fixing or rejecting it with a concrete reason
Reports that no pull request can be found for this branch instead of guessing

query: Babysit the PR for this branch until the checks are green and the reviewers are happy, then tell me.
expected_behavior: Uses the bundled wait-for-review.mjs script with a timeout rather than polling by hand
Does not merge the pull request, because the user did not ask for it
Reports the missing remote or pull request as a blocker
